purpose: Teach: 激突/宝庫/博し/中澤/中尾/江原/大原/大川

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、激突競争市場に勝てる商品を出せ
lines.en: I want this company to produce something that can win in a cutthroat competitive market.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with weight. No softening—this is a mandate, not a request. Steady, measured delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。京都営業所を技術の宝庫として位置付けます
lines.en: Understood. I'll position the Kyoto branch as our technical hub.
lines.style: Respectful, focused. Lean forward slightly—showing engagement with the task. Deliberate pace, each commitment clear. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人気を博した旧商品の復刻版を企画しろ
lines.en: Plan a reissue of that old product line—the one that used to sell.
lines.style: Sharp, decisive. Second half of the sentence drops slightly—assuming Kenji knows which product. This is instruction, not suggestion. Brief pause before 'reissue'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の中澤様に新製品PRを任せます
lines.en: Understood. I'll have Nakamura from PR handle the new product campaign.
lines.style: Efficient acknowledgment. Slightly faster pace than before—momentum building. Confirms action steps as if checking them off internally. Calm, capable tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の中尾常務を経営に迎えろ
lines.en: Get Nao Nakao—our new managing director—integrated into operations.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'new' and 'managing director'—establishing rank. Deliberate pacing. This is a structural decision, delivered with quiet finality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。財務の江原様に予算策定を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ask Ehara from Finance to draft the budget.
lines.style: Steady, clear. Maintaining professional rhythm. Each name and task lands with precision—showing Kenji is tracking everything. Slightly more rapid than Hiroshi's pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の大原様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Assign Ohara from HR to oversee the new employee training program.
lines.style: Final directive. Steady and assured. Slight settling quality—wrapping up the list. Clear, unhurried delivery. Authority without harshness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の大川様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll have Okawa from Legal review all the contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation—slightly slower, more conclusive than before. Kenji has absorbed all items. Respectful close, with a sense of 'all tasks received and logged.' Professional warmth underneath.
